build_unet_model: build a UNet model with configurable num_levels, in_channels, and base_feature_channels for feature extraction
create_unet_encoder: create a UNet encoder with DownConv layers that progressively downsample features across num_levels
create_unet_decoder: create a UNet decoder with UpConv layers that progressively upsample features and skip-connect encoder outputs
run_unet_forward: run the UNet forward pass on input tensor x to extract multi-scale feature maps
review_unet_normalization: review the UNet ImageNet normalization layer with mean [0.485, 0.456, 0.406] and std [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
